messages:
maria hsiao: seeing a clustering of OOMs across multiple shards this morning. root cause looks like KV cache growth + allocator fragmentation. starting this thread to track immediate mitigations + follow-ups.

kevin nguyen: thanks. can you attach a sample heap and jemalloc stats? will triage hotspots on insert/put paths.

maria hsiao: uploaded heap snapshots to s3://redwood-ooms/1980012345/ and jemalloc dump to s3://redwood-ooms/1980012345/jemalloc.json. pprof top shows heavy allocation in kv.Cache.put and segment.append.

samir patel: infra-bot created incident 1980012345-kv-cache-oom-cluster.

infra-bot: Incident 1980012345 created. Priority P1. Assigned: eng-runtime oncall.

lena cho: quick observation-- many allocations are small buffers from serialization and index copies. fragmentation index is ~0.45 on affected hosts.

maria hsiao: immediate tasks (short-term):
- T1: soft per-shard memory ceiling for kv-cache (owner: kevin) - ETA 12h
- T2: aggressive eviction for entries >128KB behind a feature flag (owner: lena) - ETA 6h
- T3: enable continuous heap sampling @30s for 72h (owner: samir) - ETA 1h
- T4: add growth+gc-pressure alert rule (owner: maria) - ETA 3h

kevin nguyen: implementing soft ceiling with throttled evictions to avoid crash loops. will add telemetry: miss-rate, evictions/sec, p95. plan canary rollout: 1% -> 10% -> 50%.

lena cho: opening PR for eviction rule now, will scope to canary and add unit tests simulating large-entry churn. PR #4501.

samir patel: starting heap sampling, forwarding dumps to s3 path. also scheduling a staging compaction benchmark tonight to measure fragmentation GC tradeoffs.

maria hsiao: long-term (track separately):
- L1: slab allocator + pooled arenas for hot size-classes (owner: samir + kevin) - ETA 6w
- L2: zero-copy serialization path for values >64KB (owner: lena) - ETA 3w
- L3: synthetic CI job to reproduce fragmentation and run weekly (owner: lena) - ETA 2w
- L4: allocator tuning & jemalloc config evaluation (owner: kevin) - ETA 4w

kevin nguyen: noted. will spike on arena reuse this sprint.

lena cho: quick repro snippet I'm using on staging to stress fragmentation: 
```
for i in {1..20000}; do
  size=$(( (i % 6 + 1) * 48 * 1024 ))
  curl -s -XPOST https://staging-kv/set -d "{\"k\":$i,\"v\":$(head -c $size /dev/urandom | base64)}"
done
```

maria hsiao: please post short check-ins here when milestones hit. I'll maintain the follow-up table in the postmortem doc and schedule a 30m retro in 7 days.

samir patel: EOD staging compaction results: frag index 0.47 -> 0.31, CPU +3.8%. sharing dashboard /dash/kv/frag-bench.

kevin nguyen: soft-ceiling PR opened, added metrics. plan to enable canary at 2% in the 03:00 UTC window.

lena cho: eviction canary deployed to 2% at 03:12 UTC, monitoring mem, miss-rate, p95. so far 45m stable.

maria hsiao: summary for tracking doc: T1(kevin,12h), T2(lena,6h), T3(samir,1h), T4(maria,3h); L1(samir+kevin,6w), L2(lena,3w), L3(lena,2w), L4(kevin,4w). scheduling retro and weekly "kv-frag-check" reminders to catch slow regressions. :white_check_mark:

kevin nguyen: will post 24h metric dump after canary reaches 50%.

lena cho: will upload canary heap diffs and CI repro artifacts to the s3 path when done.

samir patel: setting recurring calendar event "kv-frag-review" and adding findings to the postmortem follow-up doc.

maria hsiao: closing this thread for now; will reopen if new OOMs surface or canary regresses.
